result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but the promotional banner has a clear visual defect: its white text is rendered on a very light mint background, making the headline and instructions nearly unreadable. Other elements (header, search, filters, carousels, restaurant cards, bottom nav) appear intact.

issues.description: Promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is white on a pale mint-green background, resulting in extremely low contrast. The key promotion message and the promo code are barely legible.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker banner background (e.g., the brand's deep green) or switch the text to a dark color so it meets WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text).
